description: P0 regression 2026-08-17 addition 2: Feedly is correctly cataloged in well-known-bots.baseline.json under category 'feedfetcher' (-> BotType.GoodBot), but UserAgentAtom used to check a generic downloaded crawler-pattern list FIRST, which only ever answers BotType.Unknown -- so Feedly fell through BotTypeActionPolicies (no entry for Unknown) to the generic throttle default instead of being recognised as a legitimate feed reader. See BdfReplayTests.FeedReaderScenario_IsRecognisedAsGoodBot_NotUnknown for the BotType-specific assertion this generic bot-scenario loop doesn't check.
